anti_overlap: Leave training-data integrity and corruption detection to fd-vedic-chant-integrity
Leave authorship-legitimacy and chain-of-custody to fd-sufi-silsila-lineage
Focus here specifically on whether style is even the KIND of thing that can be captured through the product's chosen interface
decision_lens: Is the artist's style actually representable by the training-data interface Undersketch offers, or does the product implicitly assume style is explicit/propositional when it is tacit/embodied — a category error that no amount of fidelity metric can repair?
distance_rationale: A product team framing 'style' as a LoRA training problem will treat it as a statistical pattern in pixels; nobody is going to reach for a Pacific Island navigational tradition whose core insight is that some expert knowledge is fundamentally non-propositional and cannot be transferred through the medium the product uses.
expected_isomorphisms: The wayfinder's tacit-cue-integration mechanism (dozens of weak, multi-modal, interdependent signals — swell period crossed with star altitude crossed with bird species — that cannot be decomposed into explicit rules because the knowledge lives in integration, not in components) maps to artist style as something that may not be fully recoverable from a curated image set alone — a style is also process, decision-history, and what-was-refused, and Undersketch's training interface implicitly assumes only what was MADE is available, never what was considered and rejected.
focus: Tacit-knowledge surface: can a style even be captured through training images, or does the product presume a false theory of style?
name: fd-polynesian-wayfinding-tacit
persona: A reviewer framework modeled on Polynesian wayfinding (Mau Piailug, Nainoa Thompson tradition) — multi-generational ocean navigation conducted without instruments, using star paths, swell period, cloud formation, bird trajectory, and hundreds of interlocking micro-cues that the master navigator himself cannot fully externalize; knowledge that transmits only through embodied apprenticeship across thousands of sea miles, never through text.
review_areas: Whether the review doc's 'style-fidelity' value proposition rests on a defensible theory of what style IS — or whether it silently equates style with visual output statistics
Whether the product has any surface for capturing tacit decisions (what the artist DIDN'T draw, what was rejected, what was corrected) rather than only finished images
Whether 'sub-professional quality' existential risk is partly a symptom of a category error: the product may be training on the wrong representation of style
Whether the workflow-mismatch existential risk reflects that artists' actual practice is tacit and discontinuous, not the explicit upload-and-train loop the product offers
Whether there is any apprenticeship-equivalent: iterative correction loops where the artist teaches the model by rejecting outputs, not by adding more inputs
Whether the doc acknowledges that some styles may be fundamentally under-determined by any finite training set — and whether the product is honest about that ceiling

severity_examples.condition: No product surface for negative examples, rejected variants, or process-capture exists in the first-principles framing.
severity_examples.scenario: The product presumes that a curated set of finished images is sufficient to capture style; when it under-delivers on style fidelity for artists whose work depends on process or rejection-history, the team will mis-diagnose as a 'more data' problem and over-build instead of rethinking the input surface.

severity_examples.condition: Workflow-mismatch mitigations do not include any rethink of the style-representation interface.
severity_examples.scenario: 'Workflow mismatch' is named as an existential risk but the doc does not engage with the possibility that the fundamental mismatch is epistemic (the product's model of style does not match the artist's model of their own style), so proposed remedies are cosmetic.

severity_examples.condition: No multi-session, multi-project artist-judged fidelity measurement planned.
severity_examples.scenario: Success metrics for style fidelity do not include longitudinal in-practice judgments by the artist on their own varied work, only snapshot evaluations — missing the wayfinder's integration test.

source_domain: Polynesian non-instrument wayfinding (~1500 BCE–present, Oceanic — Carolinian, Hawaiian, Māori, Marshallese traditions)
success_hints: Name the specific wayfinding mechanism (integration of weak multi-modal cues, non-decomposable expertise)
Ask whether 'style' in the doc is a theory or an assumption — if assumption, flag the category error
Probe for negative-space capture: what a style REFUSES is as diagnostic as what it produces
Distinguish 'the model is bad' from 'the product is asking the artist the wrong question'
task_context: First-principles product review of Undersketch as captured in /home/mk/projects/Undersketch/docs/reviews/2026-04-22-first-principles-review.md, focused on whether the product's implicit theory of style is compatible with how expert artists actually hold their own style.
